interop_summary: Of the 51 matrix rows: real read and write with round-trip evidence only for PSD, PSB, TIFF, SVG and IDML. A vendor oracle on file behaviour exists for IDML (InDesign) and FIG (Figma PNGs); Photoshop and Illustrator oracles cover engine output, not Studio-written native files. INDD, native AI, Affinity object graph, PRPROJ, AEP, SESX are detected and refused or carried. No code at all for several rows.
pass_status_findings: V07: 7 PASS_V1 distortion and shape-conversion MTs (30545-30550, 30559) are pure nib functions with no reach outside nib; 30559 covers effects whose evaluation is refused for lack of a recovered law (live_effect.rs:593).
T08: PASS_V1 MTs 30955-30957, 31140, 31141 require features stored on the character range; StoryRange has no such field and FeatureMap is not referenced outside hsk-studio-type.
L11 and L12 PASS_V1: trap preset is a record with no trap engine, and print parameter bounds exist without a print path.

top_missing.gap: Character and paragraph attribute model. StoryRange holds only style_ref and applied_language; no per-range font, size, tracking, kerning, baseline shift, underline, OpenType features, and no indents, spacing, tabs, lists, drop caps, rules, borders, keep options. Most of what InDesign users touch on a text selection cannot be stored or composed.
top_missing.owning_crates: hsk-studio-folio (story.rs, typestyle.rs), hsk-studio-layout (typeset, threaded_reflow, styles), hsk-studio-type

top_missing.gap: Live effects on vector objects. nib::live_effect is unreachable from any document: StudioAppearanceRow has only Fill and Stroke; 7 PASS_V1 MTs prove pure functions nobody calls. Stylize contract, scribble, raster-effect settings and expand appearance are absent.
Vector procedural constructs: blend, live paint, image trace, repeat (radial, grid, mirror), symmetry, intertwine, global edit. No code at all, and these are Illustrator staples.
Native format decoders: INDD (always refused), AI native data (PDF stream only), Affinity doc.dat (container only), and no .fig writer. Every NRT row of the matrix misses its native round trip.
Font system: font resource and status records, fallback chain, library, composite fonts, colour fonts, Unicode normalisation (Normalization::Unsupported today), missing-font bulk replace.

Vertical text and CJK annotation: vertical composition, ruby, kenten, warichu, tatechuyoko, shatai, jidori, plus Arabic and Hebrew shaping controls. Kinsoku and mojikumi exist; these do not (layout/src/cjk.rs:3-4).
Text flow around objects and pagination: Folio text wrap record, autoflow modes, smart reflow, primary text frame, truncation, island spreads and document layers.

PDF writer gaps and output: tagged structure, encryption, printer marks, layout page raster export, collect-for-output package, real print path, table and cell styles, preflight rule catalogue (9 rules today).

Geometry and gradient holes: outline, hard_mix, soft_mix, trap refused; vector eraser, sculpt, point transform; document flatten; compound make/release; polarity; angular, diamond, elliptical, freeform gradients; gradient and pattern stroke; path to live shape; extended primitives.

Export and import model: StudioExportRecipe parameter map, parameter records with type codes and facets, StudioImportProfile, preset container readers (24 families), image sequence export, still-image AVIF and JPEG XL, filename tokens.
